title: Long-term Follow-up (LTFU) Study of Participants in any iECURE Protocol Using an Investigational Product (IP)
official: Long-term Follow-up (LTFU) Study of Participants in any iECURE Protocol Using an Investigational Product
summary: Main objective: To assess the long-term safety of investigational product (IP) in participants who received IP and the long-term safety of those who never received IP regardless of causality
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Enrolled in an iECURE parent protocol and have either completed or discontinued that protocol
2. Participant parent(s)/legal authorized representative (LAR) is willing and able to adhere to the protocol requirements.
3. Consent was obtained by the participants parent(s)/LAR (and participant assent, where applicable), prior to any study-related data being collected.
Exclusion criteria:
1. None

sites.f: Hospital Sant Joan De Deu Barcelona – Endocrinology
